newsitem.title: UK: Standard Chartered up on disposal report.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered up on disposal report.

text.p: Shares in Standard Chartered Plc bounced from recent weakness on Monday after a Sunday Telegraph report said the company is considering selling its Mocatta gold and base metals trading arm for as much as 200 million stg.
The stock was up 8p at 666-1/2 by 0848 GMT after last week dropping to a near-four month low.

Last week Standard shares came under pressure amid talk that ABN AMRO Hoare Govett was preparing to trim profit estimates to reflect the strength of sterling, but they were lifted on Friday as SBC Warburg repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock.

The Sunday Telegraph said Standard Chartered no longer saw Moccata as a core business and had paved the way for the disposal when the management of the gold and base metals business were merged under one head.
A spokesman for Standard said the company never commented on market rumours.
